16307-the-ascent-of-the-soul.title: The Ascent Of The Soul
16307-the-ascent-of-the-soul.creator: Unknown
16307-the-ascent-of-the-soul.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Subjects which a few years ago were regarded as the exclusive property of cultured thinkers, are now common themes of thought and conversation. Psychology has been popularized. Materialistic doctrines are at a discount even in this age of physical science.

arxiv-2109-03182.title: A Dynamic Population Model of Strategic Interaction and Migration under Epidemic Risk
arxiv-2109-03182.creator: Ezzat Elokda, Saverio Bolognani, Ashish R. Hota
arxiv-2109-03182.description: Abstract In this paper, we show how a dynamic population game can model the strategic interaction and migration decisions made by a large population of agents in response to epidemic prevalence. Specifically, we consider a modified susceptible-asymptomatic-infected-recovered (SAIR) epidemic model over multiple zones. Agents choose whether to activate (i.e.

arxiv-2109-07807.title: Error-resilient Monte Carlo quantum simulation of imaginary time
arxiv-2109-07807.creator: Mingxia Huo, Ying Li
arxiv-2109-07807.description: Abstract Computing the ground-state properties of quantum many-body systems is a promising application of near-term quantum hardware with a potential impact in many fields. The conventional algorithm quantum phase estimation uses deep circuits and requires fault-tolerant technologies. Many quantum simulation algorithms developed recently work in an inexact and variational manner to exploit shallow circuits.

arxiv-2207-09981.title: Synchronizing the helicity of Rayleigh-Bénard convection by a tide-like electromagnetic forcing
arxiv-2207-09981.creator: Peter Jüstel, Sebastian Röhrborn, Sven Eckert, Vladimir Galindo, Thomas Gundrum, Rodion Stepanov, Frank Stefani
arxiv-2207-09981.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Peter Jüstel, Sebastian Röhrborn, Sven Eckert, Vladimir Galindo, Thomas Gundrum, Rodion Stepanov, Frank Stefani. We present results on the synchronization of the helicity in a liquid-metal Rayleigh-Bénard (RB) experiment under the influence of a tide-like electromagnetic forcing with azimuthal wavenumber m = 2 m=2 .

arxiv-2208-13699.title: Graph Exploration with Embedding-Guided Layouts
arxiv-2208-13699.creator: Leixian Shen*, Zhiwei Tai*, Enya Shen, and Jianmin Wang
arxiv-2208-13699.description: Abstract Node-link diagrams are widely used to visualize graphs. Most graph layout algorithms only use graph topology for aesthetic goals (e.g., minimize node occlusions and edge crossings) or use node attributes for exploration goals (e.g., preserve visible communities). Existing hybrid methods that bind the two perspectives still suffer from various generation restrictions (e.g.

arxiv-2305-10438.title: IMAGINATOR: Pre-Trained Image+Text Joint Embeddings using Word-Level Grounding of Images
arxiv-2305-10438.creator: Varuna Krishna, S Suryavardan, Shreyash Mishra, Sathyanarayanan Ramamoorthy, Parth Patwa, Megha Chakraborty, Aman Chadha†, Amitava Das, Amit Sheth
arxiv-2305-10438.description: Abstract Word embeddings, i.e., semantically meaningful vector representation of words, are largely influenced by the distributional hypothesis "You shall know a word by the company it keeps" Harris 1954 , whereas modern prediction-based neural network embeddings rely on design choices and hyperparameter optimization. Word embeddings like Word2Vec, GloVe etc.

arxiv-2307-09210.title: Nested stochastic block model for simultaneously clustering networks and nodes
arxiv-2307-09210.creator: Nathaniel Josephs 1, Arash A. Amini 2, Marina Paez 3, Lizhen Lin 4
arxiv-2307-09210.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nathaniel Josephs 1, Arash A. Amini 2, Marina Paez 3, Lizhen Lin 4. We introduce the nested stochastic block model (NSBM) to cluster a collection of networks while simultaneously detecting communities within each network. NSBM has several appealing features including the ability to work on unlabeled networks with potentially different node sets, the flexibility to model heterogeneous communities, and the means to automatically select the number of classes for the networks and the number of communities within each network.

arxiv-2308-16701.title: A unified approach to exotic cluster structures on simple Lie groups
arxiv-2308-16701.creator: Misha Gekhtman, Michael Shapiro, Alek Vainshtein
arxiv-2308-16701.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Misha Gekhtman, Michael Shapiro, Alek Vainshtein. We propose a new approach to building log-canonical coordinate charts for any simply-connected simple Lie group 𝒢 {\mathcal{G}} and arbitrary Poisson-homogeneous bracket on 𝒢 {\mathcal{G}} associated with Belavin–Drinfeld data.

arxiv-2401-08591.title: Shogi and Frieze group
arxiv-2401-08591.creator: Yusuke Imai
arxiv-2401-08591.description: Abstract Shogi is a traditional Japanese strategy board game in the same family as chess, chaturanga, and xiangqi, and has been theoretically studied from various aspects. The research on recommended sequences of moves in each opening of shogi is called joseki ; how to use a rook (Static Rook and Ranging Rook), or how to develop a castle, etc.

arxiv-2404-15138.title: Estimating Longitudinal Polarization of Λ \Lambda and Λ ¯ \bar{\Lambda} Hyperons at Relativistic Energies using Hydrodynamic and Transport models
arxiv-2404-15138.creator: Bhagyarathi Sahoo, Captain R. Singh, Raghunath Sahoo
arxiv-2404-15138.description: Abstract The global and local spin polarization measurements of Λ \Lambda ( Λ ¯ \bar{\Lambda} ) hyperons by STAR and ALICE Collaborations open up an immense interest in investigating the spin polarization dynamics in heavy-ion collisions. Recent studies suggest the transverse component of the vorticity field is responsible for the global spin polarization.

arxiv-2504-01682.title: A result on certain sums of element orders in finite groups
arxiv-2504-01682.creator: Marius Tărnăuceanu
arxiv-2504-01682.description: Abstract Given a finite group G G of order p n ​ m p^{n}m , where p p is a prime and p ∤ m p\nmid m , we denote by ψ p ​ ( G ) \psi_{p}(G) the sum of orders of p p -parts of elements in G G .

arxiv-2507-18324.title: Plasma Position Constrained Free-Boundary MHD Equilibrium in Tokamaks using pyIPREQ
arxiv-2507-18324.creator: Udaya Maurya, Amit K. Singh, Suman Aich, Jagabandhu Kumar, Rohit Kumar, Daniel Raju
arxiv-2507-18324.description: Abstract A free-boundary, axisymmetric magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) equilibrium code, pyIPREQ, has been developed for Tokamak plasmas using finite difference and Green’s function approach. The code builds upon the foundational frameworks of the PEST and IPREQ codes, introducing several enhancements and new capabilities. Notably, pyIPREQ supports the specification of limiter boundaries and enables the computation of key physical quantities.

arxiv-2508-12013.title: Predicting ChatGPT Use in Assignments: Implications for AI-Aware Assessment Design
arxiv-2508-12013.creator: Surajit Das, Aleksei Eliseev
arxiv-2508-12013.description: Abstract The rise of generative AI tools like ChatGPT has significantly reshaped education, sparking debates about their impact on learning outcomes and academic integrity. While prior research highlights opportunities and risks, there remains a lack of quantitative analysis of student behavior when completing assignments.

arxiv-2512-07915.title: Fair Benchmarking of Optimisation Applications
arxiv-2512-07915.creator: Frank Phillipson
arxiv-2512-07915.description: Abstract Quantum optimisation is emerging as a promising approach alongside classical heuristics and specialised hardware, yet its performance is often difficult to assess fairly. Traditional benchmarking methods, rooted in digital complexity theory, do not directly capture the continuous dynamics, probabilistic outcomes, and workflow overheads of quantum and hybrid systems.

arxiv-2601-23055.title: Spectrum of bidual uniform algebras
arxiv-2601-23055.creator: Marek Kosiek, Krzysztof Rudol
arxiv-2601-23055.description: Abstract . We obtain a description of the spectrum of bidual algebra A ∗ ⁣ ∗ A^{**} of a uniform algebra A A . This spectrum turns out to be a quotient space of the hyper-Stonean envelope of the spectrum of A A . 2021 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 46J10, 32A65; Secondary 30H80 1.

britannica-1911-leiden.title: Leiden (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-leiden.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-leiden.description: Article 'Leiden' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 16), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. In spite of a certain industrial activity and the periodical bustle of its cattle and dairy markets, Leiden remains essentially an academic city. The university is a flourishing institution. It was founded by William of Orange in 1575 as a reward for the heroic defence of the previous year, the tradition being that the citizens were offered the choice between a university and a certain exemption from taxes.

pmc-10545705.title: CD1-mediated immune responses in mucosal tissues: molecular mechanisms underlying lipid antigen presentation system
pmc-10545705.creator: Seohyun Kim, Sumin Cho, Ji Hyung Kim
pmc-10545705.description: The cluster of differentiation 1 (CD1) molecule differs from major histocompatibility complex class I and II because it presents glycolipid/lipid antigens. Moreover, the CD1-restricted T cells that recognize these self and foreign antigens participate in both innate and adaptive immune responses. CD1s are constitutively expressed by professional and nonprofessional antigen-presenting cells in mucosal tissues, namely, the skin, lung, and intestine.

pmc-10670924.title: A Weakly Supervised Learning Method for Cell Detection and Tracking Using Incomplete Initial Annotations
pmc-10670924.creator: Hao Wu, Jovial Niyogisubizo, Keliang Zhao, Jintao Meng, Wenhui Xi, Hongchang Li, Yi Pan, Yanjie Wei
pmc-10670924.description: The automatic detection of cells in microscopy image sequences is a significant task in biomedical research. However, routine microscopy images with cells, which are taken during the process whereby constant division and differentiation occur, are notoriously difficult to detect due to changes in their appearance and number.

pmc-10671956.title: Trade-Offs among Immune Mechanisms: Bacterial-Challenged Spodoptera frugiperda Larvae Reduce Nodulation Reactions during Behavioral Fever
pmc-10671956.creator: Lei Zhang, Cynthia L Goodman, Joseph A Ringbauer, Xingfu Jiang, Weixiang Lv, Dianjie Xie, Tamra Reall, David Stanley, Gregory A Sword, Angela M Smilanich
pmc-10671956.description: Simple SummaryInsect innate immunity is composed of cellular and humoral reactions to infections and invasions. Cellular immunity is the first response, launched immediately when an infection is detected and it involves direct interactions between hemocytes and infecting microbes. Some insect species respond to infection with behavioral fever by moving to warmer sites or increasing exposure to heat sources.

pmc-10684291.title: COVID-19 and Adrenal Insufficiency: Unmasking the Link
pmc-10684291.creator: Carlos A Marques, Patrícia P Almeida, André M Gonçalves, Volodymyr Nagirnyak, Joana Cabeleira
pmc-10684291.description: We describe a case of a 28-year-old male who presented with general malaise, fatigue, anorexia, occasional epigastric pain, and vomiting a few days after a mild severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection. Clinical evolution led to weight loss (6 kg in six months) and craving for salty foods.

pmc-10694782.title: Virtual Reality Therapy as an Adjunct to Physiotherapy for Postoperative Pain Management: A Case Report of Laparoscopic Open Pyeloplasty for Hydronephrosis
pmc-10694782.creator: Saurabh N Puri, Swapna Jawade, Nikita S Deshmukh
pmc-10694782.description: Hydronephrosis occurs when the tubes connecting the kidneys and bladder become blocked. These tubes carry urine from the kidneys, where it is created, to the bladder, where it is stored until elimination. When one or both ureters get blocked, serious complications and symptoms might arise.

pmc-11415438.title: Oncologists’ communication about tobacco and alcohol use during treatment for esophagogastric cancer: a qualitative observational study of simulated consultations
pmc-11415438.creator: Danique W. Bos-van den Hoek, Loïs F. van de Water, Pieter G. Vos, Meeke Hoedjes, Ruud Roodbeen, Bastiaan R. Klarenbeek, Debby Geijsen, Ellen M. A. Smets, Hanneke W. M. van Laarhoven, Inge Henselmans
pmc-11415438.description: PurposeTobacco and alcohol use influence cancer risk as well as treatment outcomes, specifically for esophageal and gastric cancer patients. Therefore, it is an important topic to discuss during consultations. This study aims to uncover medical, radiation, and surgical oncologists’ communication about substance use, i.e., tobacco and alcohol use, in simulated consultations about curative and palliative esophagogastric cancer treatment.

pmc-12736404.title: Where Have We Been and Where Are We Going? The State of the Hematology and Medical Oncologist Workforce in America
pmc-12736404.creator: M Kelsey Kirkwood, Erin P Balogh, Melissa K Accordino, David D Chism, Elizabeth Garrett-Mayer, Helen M Parsons, Manali I Patel, K Robin Yabroff, Laura A Levit
pmc-12736404.description: PURPOSETo identify geographic areas and populations in the United States likely to experience challenges accessing cancer care.METHODSWe tabulated the number of hematologists and medical oncologists billing Medicare nationally, by state, and by county in 2014, 2019, and 2024, and assessed trends over time, offset by the US population age 55 years and older (where 80% of new cancers are diagnosed).

pmc-12892739.title: Music-based interventions at workplaces: a scoping review
pmc-12892739.creator: Israel Paul Nyarubeli, Bente E. Moen, Viggo Krüger, Brynjulf Stige
pmc-12892739.description: BackgroundWork-related health challenges such as work stress-related disorders, like anxiety and depression, are prevalent occupational health issues that lead to disability and an increased risk of chronic diseases. Various workplace interventions are used to reduce these health problems, but their effectiveness remains uncertain.

pmc-13167618.title: Orthognathic Surgery Using 1-Desamino-8-D-Arginine Vasopressin (DDAVP) in a Patient With Von Willebrand Disease: A Case Report
pmc-13167618.creator: Satoshi Usuda, Shin Kato, Hideyuki Shiba, Taneaki Nakagawa, Seiji Asoda
pmc-13167618.description: Von Willebrand disease (vWD) is a bleeding disorder with autosomal-dominant inheritance caused by quantitative and qualitative abnormalities in von Willebrand factor (vWF), which plays a role in primary hemostasis. In such cases, it is necessary to evaluate hemostatic function prior to surgery and take appropriate measures to manage bleeding.
